name: When should my med spa consider implementing AEO?

mainEntity.name: When should my med spa consider implementing AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your med spa should consider implementing AEO when you aim to significantly increase your online visibility, establish your practice as an authority in aesthetic treatments, and capture traffic from highly specific user queries. It's particularly beneficial if your target audience frequently uses search engines to research procedures, benefits, or local providers. Implementing AEO is also strategic if you're struggling to stand out in competitive markets through traditional SEO methods alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Med spas should implement AEO to boost online visibility, establish authority, and capture traffic from specific user questions, especially in competitive markets.
